instruction: Compress all photos in the 'IDS LLM seminar' folder into a zip file named 'seminar_photos.zip' and save it on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened the IDS LLM seminar folder, viewed photos, created a 'presenter' subfolder, copied 5 photos (incorrectly including DSC00454 which is a different person), then attempted to zip but the zip command only captured the directory entry without files. The zip was also created inside the seminar folder instead of on the Desktop.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate file manager, view images, create folders, select and move/copy files, open terminal, run basic shell commands (mkdir, cp, zip, ls)
metadata.failure_analysis: The model's zip command was incorrectly constructed: 'zip presenter.zip presenter' only added the directory entry, not the files inside. This variation isolates the zip operation with a simpler task (zip all photos, no selection needed) to test if the model can correctly create a zip file.
metadata.task_rationale: Directly targets the zip failure point from the trajectory. Removes the image recognition complexity and focuses purely on creating a correct zip file containing all photos.
metadata.explanation: Task requires compressing all 6 photos into a zip on the Desktop. Evaluator checks zip exists (0.3 points) and contains all 6 expected JPG files (0.7 points, proportional to matches).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks zip existence at /home/user/Desktop/seminar_photos.zip and lists contents using 'unzip -l' with proper basename extraction via split('/')[-1]
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': accesses expected.get('expected_files') directly from the rules dict
Scoring logic is sound: 0.3 for zip existence + 0.7 proportional to matched files, with set intersection for comparison
Complete coverage: verifies both zip location (Desktop path) and zip contents (all 6 photo filenames)
Expected values (6 JPG filenames) exactly match the 6 files set up in the config
